summary: Bitzero Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated September 14, 2026, announcing a final short form base shelf prospectus (filed September 11, 2026) in Canada allowing up to US$200,000,000 of voting shares, warrants, units, and subscription receipts over 25 months, plus an effective US Form F-10 registration statement. It also disclosed the deemed exercise on September 15, 2026 of 5,828,342 special warrants issued July 30, 2026 at US$4.25 (US$24.77M gross) into shares and US$5.00 warrants expiring July 30, 2031. No offering is being made and no at-the-market agreement exists; this is routine shelf/capital-markets housekeeping.
